note: Known-legitimate matches for content-lint.js. An entry needs a repo-relative file path, a matcher (lineText, a line number, or the exact matched string) and a short reason. lineText is a substring of the finding's source line and, when present, is what the entry matches on: it survives edits elsewhere in the file, so an entry keyed to a line that moves keeps working and the 'line' value is only a hint. Entries are deliberately narrow: they suppress one line or one matched string, never a whole file. Entries that fall back to a line number are fail-safe: if the line drifts, the entry stops matching and the finding reappears for triage.
